exposure: sociodemographic factors (age, schooling, income, steady partner, paid work)
obstetric factors (history of abdominal delivery, parity)
behavioral factors (partner's support, planned pregnancy, educational guidance, physical activity, follow-up in private service)
outcome: quality of life of pregnant women
cohort: The study included 261 low-risk pregnant women.
finding: Sociodemographic, obstetric, and behavioral factors significantly influenced the quality of life of pregnant women.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with a history of abdominal delivery expressed a better quality of life.
